# JSS Completion Fixture Project

Purpose: tiny Simple C++ JSS project used for Visual Studio Code extension fixture testing.

This project is editor-focused and exists to exercise:

- `.jss` language registration
- JSS syntax highlighting
- JSS snippets
- static completion for keywords, types, visible `let` names, function parameters, and reserved helper families
- local type-name completion after `new`

It should stay small and easy to inspect by hand.
